mLocKeys.keySummary: Xin Zhao challenges his target with his basic attacks and Audacious Charge, reducing its armor by 15% for 3 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Xin Zhao <keywordMajor>Challenges</keywordMajor> his target with his basic Attacks and <spellName>Audacious Charge</spellName>, reducing its <scaleArmor>Armor by @ArmorReductionPercent*-100@%</scaleArmor> for @Duration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended: Xin Zhao <keywordMajor>Challenges</keywordMajor> his target with his basic Attacks and <spellName>Audacious Charge</spellName>, reducing its <scaleArmor>Armor by @ArmorReductionPercent*-100@%</scaleArmor> for @Duration@ seconds. Only one target can be <keywordMajor>Challenged</keywordMajor> at a time.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Xin Zhao charges an enemy, dealing damage and slowing all enemies in the area.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Xin Zhao charges and <keywordMajor>Challenges</keywordMajor> an enemy. The charge deals <magicDamage>@TotalMagicDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to all nearby enemies and <status>Slows</status> them by @SlowAmount@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. </mainText>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Three Talon Strike</titleLeft><mainText>Xin Zhao's next three attacks deal bonus damage. His third attack also knocks his opponent into the air.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage that reduce his other ability cooldowns, with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Xin Zhao's next 3 basic Attacks deal <physicalDamage>@TotalBonusDamagePerHit@ bonus physical damage</physicalDamage> and reduce his other abilities' cooldowns by 1 second. The final strike also <status>Knocks Up</status> for @KnockupDuration@ seconds.</mainText>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Crescent Sweep</titleLeft><mainText>Xin Zhao has increased Armor and Magic Resist.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back. Xin Zhao gains bonus Armor and Magic Resist based on number of champions hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Xin Zhao unleashes a sweep around him that deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ plus @PercentCurrentHealthDamage*100@% current Health physical damage</physicalDamage> and <status>Knocks Back</status> all <keywordMajor>non-Challenged</keywordMajor> enemies. Xin Zhao gains @ScalingResist@ <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for @ResistDuration@ seconds for each champion hit.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Battle Cry</titleLeft><mainText>Xin Zhao has increased Attack Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Xin Zhao passively heals every 3 attacks and can activate this ability to attack faster.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Xin Zhao heals himself for @TotalHealAmount@ every third basic attack.

Active: Xin Zhao unleashes a Battle Cry, increasing his Attack Speed by @AttackSpeedBonus*100@% for @Duration@ seconds.
